defs.def: a public performance of music 音乐会；演奏会

ex.s: St David’s Hall is the award winning National Concert Hall of Wales standing at the very heart of Cardiff’s entertainment centre.
ex.t: St David's Hall是威尔士获奖的国家音乐厅，位于卡迪夫娱乐中心的核心地带。

ex.s: With an impressive 2,000-seat concert hall, St David’s Hall is home to the annual Welsh Proms Cardiff.
ex.t: 圣大卫音乐厅拥有令人印象深刻的2000座音乐厅，是每年加的夫威尔士逍遥音乐节的所在地。

ex.s: Most page turners are piano students or up-and-coming concert pianists, although Ms Raspopova has once asked her husband to help her out on stage.
ex.t: 大多数翻谱员是钢琴学生或崭露头角的音乐会钢琴家，尽管拉斯波波娃女士曾经让她丈夫在台上帮忙。

ex.s: They performed their first concert in America at CBS television's 53rd street studio.
ex.t: 他们在CBS电视台的53街工作室表演了他们在美国的首场演唱会。

ex.s: Last year, Moran worked on a project that arranged Fats Waller’s music for a dance party, “Just to kind of put it back in the mind that Waller is dance music as much as it is concert music,” says Moran.
ex.t: 去年，莫兰参与了一个项目，将法茨·沃勒的音乐改编用于舞会，“就是想让人重新意识到，沃勒的音乐既是舞曲也是音乐会音乐，”莫兰说。

ex.s: Shopping centres have been organising events and activities to celebrate Chinese Spring Festival for years, while concerts and other performances are also proving a big success.
ex.t: 多年来，购物中心一直组织活动庆祝中国春节，而音乐会和其他演出也同样大获成功。

ex.s: Tickets for the 2017 Grand Chinese New Year Concert in St Petersburg sold out, with 90% of the audience local Russians.
ex.t: 2017年圣彼得堡中国新年音乐会的门票售罄， 90%的观众是俄罗斯当地人。

ex.s: It had a cafe selling organic food, and there were now more community events such as book readings, poetry recitals and even jazz concerts and movie nights, where people could gather to share an experience that couldn’t be downloaded.
ex.t: 它有一家卖有机食品的咖啡馆，现在还有更多的社区活动，比如读书会、诗歌朗诵会，甚至爵士音乐会和电影之夜，人们可以聚在一起分享一种无法下载的体验。

ex.s: However, after learning for about six months, I was asked to perform something at the year-end concert arranged by my teacher.
ex.t: 然而，在学习了大约六个月后，我被要求在老师安排的年终音乐会上表演一些东西。

ex.s: On the day of the concert, I was so nervous that I woke up with butterflies in my stomach.
ex.t: 音乐会那天，我紧张得醒来时心里七上八下的。
